- 与本地记忆中 kvm-x86 相关条目无人物重合，不混淆。

## 已确认来源（documented, primary / first_hand_other）
1. GitHub Blog 作者页 (https://github.blog/author/mymo/) — 16 篇 + Page2 9 篇 = 25 篇 writeup，跨度 2020-04 ~ 2026-03. WebFetch 成功。
2. "Rooting with root cause: finding a variant of a Project Zero bug" (2023-05-25, https://github.blog/security/vulnerability-research/rooting-with-root-cause-finding-a-variant-of-a-project-zero-bug/). WebFetch 成功，正文确认:
   - 显式以 Project Zero issue 2327 (CVE-2022-36449) 为研究起点.
   - 点名 Jann Horn (Google Project Zero) 为原始漏洞披露者, 并引用其两项技术 (2019 Linux Security Summit EU "Exploiting race conditions on [ancient] Linux" + P0 博客 "Racing against the clock—hitting a tiny kernel race window"), 称后者 "is just what I need here".
   - 通过 root cause analysis 找到 variant CVE-2022-46395 (报 Arm 2022-11-17, r42p0 修复, Android 2023-05 公告), 并公开发表 writeup.
   - 结论原话短引: "shows how important it is to carry out root cause analysis of existing vulnerabilities and to use the knowledge to identify new variants of an issue."

## reported（writeup 元数据层，未单独抓正文）

4. "Chrome in-the-wild bug analysis: CVE-2021-30632" (2021-09-27) — Chrome JIT 野外漏洞复盘.
   (均来自 author 页 Page2 WebFetch, 体现对社区野外漏洞动态的公开跟踪分析.)

- POC 会议材料 WebSearch 无摘要; 未确认.

- WebFetch: 4 次 (author p1, author p2, rooting writeup, blackhat 403).
- WebSearch: 4 次 (GSL browser/kernel, Pwn2Own/CVE reporter, Black Hat speaker, POC). 均达上限或无摘要.

- 反馈回路可 documented: Mo 通过阅读 P0 公开报告 (Jann Horn) → 提取 root cause 与技术方法 → 发现 variant → 公开 writeup 回馈社区; 且连续 in-the-wild 分析构成对社区漏洞动态的持续公开复盘.
